subject: CEGL
title: English Language and Culture - Elementary 1
description: Speaking, writing, listening, and reading at a lower-elementary English level. Essential linguistic, communicative, and socio-cultural skills required to function in familiar situations related to daily life and familiar interactions. Strategies for independent learning and cultural discovery.
